hash_convention.input: Exact file bytes, with no whitespace or JSON normalization.
hash_convention.verification_rule: Collect all files in groups and excluded_groups. Require exactly one null sha256, belonging to self_hash_exclusion. Skip that one record only; every other record must equal hashlib.sha256(Path(record["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(). The manifest has no claimed final-file self digest.
